question_bank.stem: In an AI-assisted software project where a clear spec can become code quickly, what should the builder prioritize to avoid the new bottleneck?

options.label: A
options.text: Writing more implementation code before asking users what they need.

options.label: B
options.text: Choosing a larger engineering team before clarifying the product goal.

options.label: C
options.text: Using user feedback and clear specs to decide what should be built.

options.label: D
options.text: Delaying prototypes until every product assumption is already fixed.

question_bank.correct_answer: Using user feedback and clear specs to decide what should be built.
question_bank.explanation: Andrew says building has become cheaper and faster, so the harder bottleneck shifts toward deciding what to build through specs, feedback, and iteration.
